title: Autopsy and Ledger
author: O. M. Villalobos
blurb: Jonah Nakamura, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
